evidence.supports: Detailed meeting summary of the March 16, 2026 Commissioners' vote: unanimous adoption, statutory citations (IC 36-7-2-8, IC 36-8-4-603), and County Attorney's framing of the moratorium as a procedural pause, not a prohibition on future development.

Commissioners framed the moratorium as a procedural pause — not a prohibition on future development.
